Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for claim file purposes. Can you
confirm you're comfortable with that?
A: Yes, that's fine.
Q: Great. Can you walk me through what happened on the day of the accident?
A: I was stopped at a red light on a main road in Pasadena, Texas, in the right lane. The car behind me didn't stop in
time and hit me from the rear. It wasn't a huge impact, but it was enough to push my car forward a bit.
Q: Were you able to drive your vehicle from the scene?
A: Yes, it was drivable, so I pulled into a parking lot nearby and waited for the police to show up.
Q: Did an officer come out and wirte a report?
A: Yes, an officer came out, took statements from both of us, and gave me a card with a report number on it.
Q: How are you feeling physically since the accident?
A: My neck is pretty sore, mostly in the back and on the left side. I also get a stiff feeling when I turn my head to check
my blind spot while driving.
Q: Have you seen a medical provider about this?
A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic the same day. They checked my range of motion, prescribed some muscle
relaxers, and told me I had a neck strain.
Q: Have you had any follow-up treatment since then?
A: I've been going to physical therapy twice a week. It helps a little, but I still have bad days where I can't turn my
head comfortably.
Q: Did you have any neck or back problems before the accident?
A: No, not that I can recall. I was active and didn't have any ongoing issues with my neck.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the accident or your injuries?
A: Not right now. I just want to get back to normal and be able to work without pain.
Q: Thank you. We'll follow up with you once we've reviewed the information. Have a good day.
A: Thanks, you too.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page

- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

- "reason": one short sentence.
